testResults.name: entra-jwt-authenticator
testResults.result: New EntraJwtAuthenticator validated with locally minted RSA tokens and a network-free JWKS stub: v1 sts.windows.net and v2 login.microsoftonline.com issuer forms accepted, audience equality enforced, Lake.Access role claim required, expired/tampered/wrong-key/missing-role tokens rejected with the stable 401 shape, and combined authenticator falls back to the static bearer for non-JWT credentials while keeping bearer-only behavior when Entra configuration is absent or blank

testResults.name: lakeclient-token-credential
testResults.result: LakeClient accepts exactly one of bearer_token or credential+audience, attaches acquired tokens per request through an httpx auth flow, and retries once with a freshly acquired token on 401 before raising LakeClientError; fake TokenCredential tests run network-free

testResults.name: hosted-composition-regression
testResults.command: uv run --python 3.12 --extra dev pytest tests/lake/hosted tests/lake/configuration -q
testResults.result: Hosted composition and configuration suites pass with the new auth settings model

testResults.name: infrastructure-and-workflow
testResults.result: Both Bicep files compile; the API container receives LAKE_API__AUTH__ENTRA_TENANT_ID from tenant().tenantId and LAKE_API__AUTH__ENTRA_AUDIENCE conditionally when the lakeApiAudience parameter is non-empty; deploy-main.yml passes lakeApiAudience from vars.LAKE_API_AUDIENCE without adding it to the required-input gate so deploys stay green when unset

testResults.name: repository-wide-quality-gates
testResults.result: Repository-wide Ruff lint, format check, ty type check, and the complete pytest suite passed with 894 tests after wave integration

limitations: A JWT-shaped static bearer string would be routed to Entra validation and rejected when Entra configuration is enabled; the static path is intended for local random secrets
Hosted enforcement activates only when the LAKE_API_AUDIENCE GitHub Environment variable and Bicep parameter are non-empty; empty keeps the deployment on static-bearer-only
